description: This file defines a utility function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for visualization with the Recharts library. It groups data by specified categories and services, fills in missing data points with zeros, and sorts the categories and services as configured.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries(records, stackBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms a list of cost records into a structured dataset for stacked series visualization, with zero-filling for missing categories and optional sorting.
